author: piphop
text:
Ifmyante wrote: Yay!

I thought I might be so bold as to see if I can pick up a few clues as
to why IF took this trade. If I manage to get a few at least I may have
taught myself something.

1. Price is at a RBD on the Daily and 4H. This cap on price therefore
becomes the level of 4H and Daily Supply (as per IF's video S and D
levels in multiple TF's)

2. There is a general S/R Zone at this level.

3. Back in the past 6th September 2013 an important decision was made for pirice to head higher around this level.

4. On the 15m when price got up to the top of the RBD at .9132 it showed
 signs of weakness by spiking this level but not convincingly closing
above it.

5. I also identified a Bearish QM on the 5m, but IF was already in. I am
 unable to get enough history to see the 1m but I doubt very much that I
 would find anything in there that would enlighten me on his sharp
entries.

Congrats IF and thanks for sharing the trade.
